triage.reason: PackUK's page announces a new 1 September 2026 resubmission deadline for 2025 packaging data and publication of RAM 2027 guidance under the UK pEPR scheme.

draft.summary: PackUK has introduced a resubmission deadline of 1 September 2026 for 2025 packaging data to affect Notices of Liability.
